meta.name: muapi-drone-style-video
meta.description: Generate aerial drone-perspective footage — sweeping bird's-eye views, orbit shots, and flyover sequences for landscapes, architecture, and events.

copy.tagline: 生成航拍视角的鸟瞰、环绕和飞越镜头
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要制作无人机风格的视频素材
copy.tagline_en: Generate aerial drone-perspective footage with sweeping views
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create drone-style video footage

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你的描述生成无人机视角的航拍视频，比如鸟瞰、环绕或飞越镜头，并支持调整画面风格和比例。
howto.when: 当你提到“无人机”、“航拍”、“鸟瞰”等关键词，或要求生成空中视角视频时触发。

say.text: 生成一段山谷日出的无人机飞越视频。
say.note: 会调用默认的 reveal 镜头生成视频。

say.text: 用环绕镜头拍一栋海边别墅，风格为蓝色时刻。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate drone-perspective aerial videos (bird's-eye, orbit, flyover) based on your description, with adjustable style and aspect ratio.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like 'drone', 'aerial', 'bird's eye', or ask for aerial footage.

say_en.text: Generate a drone flyover video of a mountain valley at sunrise.
Create an orbit shot of a beachfront villa in blue hour style.
say_en.note: Sets shot_type to orbit and style to blue hour.
